simple.summary: שָׂקַר (sâqar) means to ogle , i.e. blink coquettishly First listed occurrence: Isa 3 16.

definitions.full: H8265. saqar [ שָׂקַר ] verb Pi`el ogle (Aramaic סְקַר look at ( ᵑ7 Job 20:9 ; 28:7 ), סַקְרָנִית looking about, ogling ; eye with envy or hatred (e.g. 1Sam 18:9 ᵑ6 ); compare De Is ); — Participle feminine plural עֵינַיִם מְשַׂקְּרוֺת Isa 3:16 ogling of eyes (women of Jerusalem). שַׂר see שׂרר .
